scheduling: native train_async.py one-batch-ahead; not fully-async persistent worker
instrumentation: per-rank memory and offload wall time
GPU telemetry, IB counter deltas, NCCL logs, SGLang Prometheus

matched_workload.initial_weights: original base-model checkpoint, not the trained step_2 checkpoint
matched_workload.advantages: reward minus group mean, without dividing by group standard deviation

gradient_reduction_dtype.reason: Megatron BF16 training validation requires FP32 gradient accumulation/reduction

inference_parallelism_notation.miles: SGLang global TP16, attention DP2 with attention TP8, EP16

prefill_cuda_graphs.reason: Pinned SGLang breakable prefill graph shape error in job187

cpu_numa_binding.miles: SGLang automatic NUMA affinity skipped in inner container; all CPUs and both NUMA nodes allowed

schedule.baseline: asynchronous group prefetch and zero-advantage filtering
schedule.miles: synchronous two-step, cyclic same four tasks, zero-advantage filtering

inference_moe_kernel.reason: Pinned Miles Blackwell recipe documents identical weight-sync shape failure and selects this backend.

router_precision_kernel.miles: Job-local ReplicatedLinear subclass using BF16-input torch.mm(out_dtype=float32); same canonical BF16 parameter storage
router_precision_kernel.reason: Pinned SGLang Qwen gate does not honor the baseline FP32 router-logit option.

request_routing.reason: Default cache-aware policy concentrated all observed workload requests on attention DP0.

ppo_changes.critic: colocated on actor GPUs with train offload
ppo_changes.truncation: native GAE zero bootstrap; terminal observed reward retained

comparison_limitations: two updates; no held-out quality evidence
task source/order/batch settings match; sampled outcomes and accepted task mix do not
same base weights; warmed image and conversion caches
weights-only actor/critic checkpoints; no optimizer/RNG resume test
native PPO adds critic work and keeps zero-variance groups
